purpose: Conformance vectors for the promptlsh lexical digest. An independent implementation is conformant when, for every vector, it reproduces 'digest' exactly from 'input_codepoints' under 'params'. See SPEC-digest.md.
canonicalisation: NFKC -> drop category Cf -> case fold -> NFKC

fixes_relative_to_plm1.fix: NFKC normalisation, applied before and after case folding so the result is idempotent.
fixes_relative_to_plm1.expected: these two vectors now produce the SAME digest

fixes_relative_to_plm1.fix: Characters in Unicode category Cf are removed during canonicalisation.
fixes_relative_to_plm1.expected: these two vectors now produce the SAME digest

fixes_relative_to_plm1.fix: shingle_size and seed are carried on the wire, so digests built with different parameters are rejected instead of scored.
